TileMask.modifications: Source-aligned cavity segmentation: a=AO/255; t=clamp((a-.90)/.09,0,1); s=t*t*(3-2*t); output=round(255*periodic3x3minimum(s)). No spatial hex/grid invented; one-pixel erosion conservatively excludes grout.
TileMask.segmentation_rationale: Absolute Height varies between tilted tile planes and would misclassify low tiles. Actual cavity AO is1 across tile interiors and lower along source grout, allowing stable source-aligned segmentation.

TileMask.usage: R=tile/glaze coverage;1tile0grout. Linear map, sample with exact same UVs as sourceBC/N/R.
